name: Building planning energy consumption benchmark evaluation system
description: A system and benchmark for evaluating building planning energy consumption predictions using regression and data-mining techniques to compare models and planners.
evaluation_method: regression metrics (RMSE, MAE, MAPE) and goodness-of-fit (R²)
reputation: A niche academic benchmark introduced for building energy planning research with limited community adoption outside the energy-modeling research community.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on regression/forecasting; results are sensitive to temporal splitting and feature engineering. Potential small/heterogeneous dataset sizes and risk of temporal leakage if evaluation folds are not properly constructed.
